# Realization of SLM engineeer

We use Laser collimator with parameter A18.4 that accept a 1013 nm laser.
Then the beam is diffracted outputed directly on the SLM focal plane, reflected to an objective lens with focal length 20 cm. The camera is placed approximately 25 cm after the objective lens.

The camera is Allied Vision 1800 U-1240m (Alvium 1800 series) with sensor 4024 × 3036 (Sony IMX226, pixel size = 1.85 μm)
